name: 5dive-voice
description: The 5dive voice plugin, published from its own repository. One plugin, one repo — the shape `5dive plugin add <owner>/<repo>` was built for.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: Speak with your agent and hear it talk back — local speech-to-text and text-to-speech. The reference implementation of the 5dive plugin contract: a channel-capability plugin, the shape every later channel plugin copies.
